title: Corporate Discount Eligibility across the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Whether a corporate travel programme discount may reach a fare at all is a property of the fare brand, and is scheduled for each of the Air Ticket Fare Brands as a single term: whether that brand is eligible for a corporate discount.

| Fare brand | Eligible for a corporate discount |
| --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | no |
| Economy Saver | no |
| Economy Classic | yes |
| Economy Flex | yes |
| Premium Economy Select | yes |
| Business Saver | yes |
| Business Flex | yes |

## The line the schedule draws

Eligibility turns between Economy Saver and Economy Classic. The two brands below the line are scheduled as not eligible; the five from Economy Classic upwards are scheduled as eligible.

## Points of judgement

**Is eligibility a property of the traveller or of the brand?** Of the brand. The schedule states one term per brand and states it without reference to who is travelling or which programme is held.

**Does the schedule state the size of any discount?** It does not. It states eligibility alone, brand by brand; what a given programme has negotiated is a term of that programme.

**Hypothetical reading.** Of a hypothetical pair of bookings, one in Economy Saver and one in Economy Classic, this schedule marks only the second as eligible for a corporate discount, whatever the two bookings otherwise have in common.
